text:
liz: Quick sync — final scope freeze in ~24h. Need clear owners for SLA bullets, docs + runbook, monitoring smoke, and the pricing note. Who can take which?

aj: I can own SLA wording and the SLI targets. Will draft a short PR by EOD and include rationale for p50/p95.

maria: I’ll take docs + quickstart updates. Can someone send the final flag list? @aj can you call out the SLO numbers when you have them so I can wire examples?

aj: Yup. Current thinking: SLO 99.5% availability, latency p50 200ms, p95 800ms for hosted. I’ll put the numbers + measurement windows in the PR.

devin: I’ll own the oncall/escalation runbook and incident play. Planning to add circuit-breaker and graceful-fallback examples (route to smaller model or degraded feature).

sam: Monitoring: I’ll create the dashboards and alerts. Need the SLOs and any new runtime metrics (batching_ratio, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_variant_fallbacks).

liz: Legal side — @marco, are there any contract blockers for Dedicated / Private deployment SLAs we should flag now?

marco: I’m reviewing T&Cs for Dedicated. A couple of items around data residency and KMS obligations; probably 1 blocker that needs precise wording (ETA tomorrow morning).

opsbot: deploy-bot: heads-up — prod-freeze scheduled to start in ~22h unless blockers are posted. See <https://deploys/redwood/1234> for details.

maria: Quick doc question — do we publish the quantization recommendations publicly or keep a deep-dive internal? Some customers expect the short how-to in public docs.

liz: Public short guidance + internal deep-dive is the plan. Keep the step-by-step public, full perf tradeoffs internal.

aj: SLO PR: <https://git.redwood/slo/PR-456> — adding measurement windows and alerting hints.

devin: Runbook draft (snippet):
```
- who to page: oncall -> eng-sre -> product
- fallback: route to compatible smaller model variant
- rollback: automated config toggle + manual rollback steps
- customer comms: template + timeline
```

sam: I’ll add panels: latency_by_model, cost_per_token, kv_cache_hit_rate, prefix_cache_hit_ratio. Will also set alert thresholds once aj confirms numbers.

liz: OK owners captured. I’ll consolidate into one short checklist in Confluence and ping execs after legal signs off. Add any safety-net asks to #release-war-room.

aj: ack :thumbsup:

maria: ack

marco: ack (will update here when I have exact wording)

opsbot: reminder: post last-minute safety-net requests in #release-war-room.
